# Third-party notices

The Windows executable bundles a Python runtime, Tcl/Tk and the PyInstaller bootloader.
Their license notices are included alongside the application's MIT license:

- CPython: [Python license](https://docs.python.org/3/license.html), including notices for additional runtime components.
- Tcl: [Tcl license terms](https://github.com/tcltk/tcl/blob/core-8-6-branch/license.terms).
- Tk: [Tk license terms](https://github.com/tcltk/tk/blob/core-8-6-branch/license.terms).
- PyInstaller: [license and bootloader exception](https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/blob/develop/COPYING.txt).

These notices do not change the MIT license for this project's own source code.
